# NBAPI 1.5.1

## HA reliability

- Kept `/api/ha/health` outside the global API rate limiter so a standby Redis replica is never asked to execute a write-based rate-limit script.
- Restored the expected standby health response instead of masking it with an internal-server-error response.
- Stopped slave nodes from writing system-instance heartbeats into read-only PostgreSQL standbys.

## Validation

- Added regression coverage for the read-only HA health path and standby system-instance reporting behavior.
